# GroupSelfHide

Hides your own frame in raid-style party frames.

## Features

- **Hide mode** - hides your own frame and the "Party" label; the gap stays.
- **Fill mode** - also widens the other frames so the group keeps its width (2-5 players).
- **Scope guard** - inactive in raids and with a vertical party layout; changes apply out
  of combat only.
- **Remembered** - settings are saved per account, or per character with one checkbox;
  default is off.
- **Settings page** - all options in the game menu under Options > AddOns, also opened
  from the addon compartment menu.
- **Chat commands** - every option can also be changed by slash command.

## Screenshots

Before (own frame shown) and after (`/gsh fill`):

![Before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tf4482/GroupSelfHide/main/docs/before.png)
![After](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tf4482/GroupSelfHide/main/docs/after.png)

## Install

1. Download `GroupSelfHide-vX.Y.Z.zip` from the
   [releases](https://github.com/tf4482/GroupSelfHide/releases) (or CurseForge, Wago).
2. Unzip it into `World of Warcraft/_forever_/Interface/AddOns/`.
3. Restart the game or type `/reload`.

## Usage

```text
/gsh                show the current mode
/gsh fill           hide your frame and widen the others
/gsh hide           hide your frame, keep the gap
/gsh off            show your frame again
/gsh character on   use settings for this character only
/gsh character off  use the account settings again
/gsh test           apply the mode once now
/gsh reset          reset the settings to defaults
/gsh debug on       show what the addon does, until /reload
/gsh config         open the settings page
/gsh help           list all commands
```

## Examples

- In a 5-player party, `/gsh fill` closes the gap; the other four frames grow to the old
  total width.
- `/gsh hide` only hides your frame, the other frames keep their size.
- In a raid or with vertical party frames, the mode stays saved but does nothing;
  `/gsh` says so.
- Typed during combat, a mode change applies right after combat.
- `/gsh character on`, then `/gsh off` on a healer keeps the frame there while other
  characters still hide it.

## Develop

Check the code with [Luacheck](https://github.com/lunarmodules/luacheck) before each commit
(CI runs it on every push):

```text
luacheck .
```

Deploy locally: run `deploy.bat`; it builds `release/GroupSelfHide-vX.Y.Z.zip` from `VERSION`.

Release: set `VERSION` to `X.Y.Z`, then push an annotated tag `vX.Y.Z`; GitHub Actions
packages the addon with the BigWigs packager and publishes it.

# Changelog

All notable changes to this project are documented in this file.
The format follows [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/) and
[Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/).

## [Unreleased]

## [0.5.2] - 2026-11-27

### Changed

- Wider dropdowns on the settings page, without the arrows beside them

## [0.5.1] - 2026-11-24

### Added

- Releases are published on CurseForge

## [0.5.0] - 2026-11-24

### Added

- Settings page (Esc > Options > AddOns) and addon compartment entry
- `/gsh config` opens the settings page, `/gsh help` lists all commands
- "Per character" checkbox and `/gsh character on|off`: settings per character or per
  account (saved in the new `GroupSelfHideCharDB`; the account mode stays as it was)
- `/gsh test` applies the mode once now, `/gsh reset` restores the defaults,
  `/gsh debug on|off` shows what the addon does

### Changed

- `/gsh` shows the current mode; `/gsh fill`, `/gsh hide`, and `/gsh off` set it
- Release zips are built on GitHub and named `GroupSelfHide-vX.Y.Z.zip`
- WoW Forever only: the TOC no longer lists the Retail interface number

### Fixed

- Stutter and flicker from updates of unrelated compact frames such as raid frames and
  nameplates; party frame updates in quick succession now apply once

## [0.4.2] - 2026-11-18

### Changed

- README: detail license terms

## [0.4.1] - 2026-11-18

### Changed

- README: add license section

## [0.4.0] - 2026-11-07

### Changed

- `/gsh` is now the fill mode, `/gsh hide` the hide mode
- Calling a command while a mode is active switches back to normal
- Default is off

### Added

- Addon stays inactive in raids and with a vertical party layout

### Removed

- `/gsh fill` and `/gsh help`

## [0.3.1] - 2026-11-07

### Changed

- README: add screenshots, simplify description

## [0.3.0] - 2026-11-07

### Added

- Fill mode (`/gsh fill`) widens the other party frames to keep the group width
- `/gsh hide` selects the plain hide mode
- `/gsh help` prints a short usage text in the client language (German, otherwise English)

## [0.2.0] - 2026-11-07

### Added

- Hide the "Party" label while the own frame is hidden

## [0.1.0] - 2026-11-07

### Added

- Hide the player's own frame in raid-style group frames
- `/gsh` command to toggle, persisted across sessions
